_note: Kawasemi-yu's changing room (2026-11-22, Baths step 2): a map of its own between the lobby (data/maps/sento.json, through the noren in the left wall) and the bath (data/maps/sento_bath.json, through the glass sliding door in the right wall), so the lobby never sees into it (the user's point). `towel` "allowed": the farmer may be in a towel here. The shelf of baskets ("use": "change": E puts the clothes in a basket and wraps a towel round the farmer, E again dresses again; Game.change_clothes), a bench for drying off. The bath's door only lets the farmer through in a towel (`towel`), the lobby's only dressed (`dressed`). The clock stands still in here like in every building. Format: README.md, Maps.
